en.text: Then Job answered,

zhSimplified.text: 约伯回答说：

zhTraditional.text: 約伯回答說：

en.text: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

zhSimplified.text: 惟愿我的烦恼称一称， 我一切的灾害放在天平里；

zhTraditional.text: 惟願我的煩惱稱一稱， 我一切的災害放在天平裏；

en.text: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

zhSimplified.text: 现今都比海沙更重， 所以我的言语急躁。

zhTraditional.text: 現今都比海沙更重， 所以我的言語急躁。

en.text: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

zhSimplified.text: 因全能者的箭射入我身； 其毒，我的灵喝尽了； 神的惊吓摆阵攻击我。

zhTraditional.text: 因全能者的箭射入我身； 其毒，我的靈喝盡了； 上帝的驚嚇擺陣攻擊我。

en.text: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

zhSimplified.text: 野驴有草岂能叫唤？ 牛有料岂能吼叫？

zhTraditional.text: 野驢有草豈能叫喚？ 牛有料豈能吼叫？

en.text: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

zhSimplified.text: 物淡而无盐岂可吃吗？ 蛋青有什么滋味呢？

zhTraditional.text: 物淡而無鹽豈可吃嗎？ 蛋青有甚麼滋味呢？

en.text: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

zhSimplified.text: 看为可厌的食物， 我心不肯挨近。

zhTraditional.text: 看為可厭的食物， 我心不肯挨近。

en.text: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

zhSimplified.text: 惟愿我得着所求的， 愿 神赐我所切望的；

zhTraditional.text: 惟願我得着所求的， 願上帝賜我所切望的；

en.text: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

zhSimplified.text: 就是愿 神把我压碎， 伸手将我剪除。

zhTraditional.text: 就是願上帝把我壓碎， 伸手將我剪除。

en.text: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

zhSimplified.text: 我因没有违弃那圣者的言语， 就仍以此为安慰， 在不止息的痛苦中还可踊跃。

zhTraditional.text: 我因沒有違棄那聖者的言語， 就仍以此為安慰， 在不止息的痛苦中還可踴躍。

en.text: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

zhSimplified.text: 我有什么气力使我等候？ 我有什么结局使我忍耐？

zhTraditional.text: 我有甚麼氣力使我等候？ 我有甚麼結局使我忍耐？

en.text: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

zhSimplified.text: 我的气力岂是石头的气力？ 我的肉身岂是铜的呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我的氣力豈是石頭的氣力？ 我的肉身豈是銅的呢？

en.text: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

zhSimplified.text: 在我岂不是毫无帮助吗？ 智慧岂不是从我心中赶出净尽吗？

zhTraditional.text: 在我豈不是毫無幫助嗎？ 智慧豈不是從我心中趕出淨盡嗎？

en.text: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

zhSimplified.text: 那将要灰心、离弃全能者、 不敬畏 神的人， 他的朋友当以慈爱待他。

zhTraditional.text: 那將要灰心、離棄全能者、 不敬畏上帝的人， 他的朋友當以慈愛待他。

en.text: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

zhSimplified.text: 我的弟兄诡诈，好像溪水， 又像溪水流干的河道。

zhTraditional.text: 我的弟兄詭詐，好像溪水， 又像溪水流乾的河道。

en.text: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

zhSimplified.text: 这河因结冰发黑， 有雪藏在其中；

zhTraditional.text: 這河因結冰發黑， 有雪藏在其中；

en.text: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

zhSimplified.text: 天气渐暖就随时消化， 日头炎热便从原处干涸。

zhTraditional.text: 天氣漸暖就隨時消化， 日頭炎熱便從原處乾涸。

en.text: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

zhSimplified.text: 结伴的客旅离弃大道， 顺河偏行，到荒野之地死亡。

zhTraditional.text: 結伴的客旅離棄大道， 順河偏行，到荒野之地死亡。

en.text: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

zhSimplified.text: 提玛结伴的客旅瞻望； 示巴同伙的人等候。

zhTraditional.text: 提瑪結伴的客旅瞻望； 示巴同夥的人等候。

en.text: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

zhSimplified.text: 他们因失了盼望就抱愧， 来到那里便蒙羞。

zhTraditional.text: 他們因失了盼望就抱愧， 來到那裏便蒙羞。

en.text: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

zhSimplified.text: 现在你们正是这样， 看见惊吓的事便惧怕。

zhTraditional.text: 現在你們正是這樣， 看見驚嚇的事便懼怕。

en.text: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

zhSimplified.text: 我岂说：请你们供给我， 从你们的财物中送礼物给我？

zhTraditional.text: 我豈說：請你們供給我， 從你們的財物中送禮物給我？

en.text: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

zhSimplified.text: 岂说：拯救我脱离敌人的手吗？ 救赎我脱离强暴人的手吗？

zhTraditional.text: 豈說：拯救我脫離敵人的手嗎？ 救贖我脫離強暴人的手嗎？

en.text: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

zhSimplified.text: 请你们教导我，我便不作声； 使我明白在何事上有错。

zhTraditional.text: 請你們教導我，我便不作聲； 使我明白在何事上有錯。

en.text: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

zhSimplified.text: 正直的言语力量何其大！ 但你们责备是责备什么呢？

zhTraditional.text: 正直的言語力量何其大！ 但你們責備是責備甚麼呢？

en.text: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

zhSimplified.text: 绝望人的讲论既然如风， 你们还想要驳正言语吗？

zhTraditional.text: 絕望人的講論既然如風， 你們還想要駁正言語嗎？

en.text: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

zhSimplified.text: 你们想为孤儿拈阄， 以朋友当货物。

zhTraditional.text: 你們想為孤兒拈鬮， 以朋友當貨物。

en.text: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

zhSimplified.text: 现在请你们看看我， 我决不当面说谎。

zhTraditional.text: 現在請你們看看我， 我決不當面說謊。

en.text: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 请你们转意，不要不公； 请再转意，我的事有理。

zhTraditional.text: 請你們轉意，不要不公； 請再轉意，我的事有理。

en.text: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

zhSimplified.text: 我的舌上岂有不义吗？ 我的口里岂不辨奸恶吗？

zhTraditional.text: 我的舌上豈有不義嗎？ 我的口裏豈不辨奸惡嗎？
